components.navigation: Top or side navigation with clear active states (Volt Blue border/text). Desktop links visible, mobile hamburger.
components.tables_lists: Dense rows, 1px bottom border between items, high contrast labels.
components.charts: Recharts with transparent backgrounds, Volt Blue and Electric Blaze lines, white axis text.
components.progress_bars: bg-[#141414] overflow-hidden with h-full bg-[#007AFF] or #FF3B30. No rounded corners.
components.streak_tracker: Grid of small squares (like GitHub contributions) or bold typography indicating days.
components.cards: Cardless look or sharp rectangular shapes. Do not use soft roundness.

instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react (default) or install @phosphor-icons/react. For fitness apps, bold/duotone Phosphor icons look great. Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` if choosing Phosphor.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Include fonts via Google Fonts in index.html or layout: Barlow Condensed (Headings), DM Sans (Body).
instructions_to_main_agent.theming: Ensure the application strictly uses dark mode with deep black (#0A0A0A) as base. Avoid grey (#808080). Text must have high contrast.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, workout cards) MUST have `data-testid` attributes in kebab-case.
